items.title: Daryl Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 11, 2024
items.q: "You know, Cookie," ( he called everybody Cookie but I was number one Cookie) "Cookie, I must talk to you about your vibrato."

ctx.x: Don’t you want to say something to them like —
My father all those years ago, when I was like eight and nine or twelve, “Don’t be” you know, “Don’t be like all those people who —” and he just did exactly what you said. © Fillius Jazz Archive -10-

Amateurs. “Don’t be an amateur. You need to know your keys and tell them you’re going to do it in this key and you’re going to go back to the bridge and then you’re going to take it out.” And he showed me all the terms. And, “You know, Cookie,” ( he called everybody Cookie but I was number one Cookie) “Cookie, I must talk to you about your vibrato. You’re getting a nanny. Oh he should hear me now.
